description: Post the connected account's hot take on a CarlNotes finding, podcast episode, topic, or Open Mic post, or a reply to one: plain text of up to 2000 characters, where @username mentions someone. A hot take is public wherever its topic is. On a podcast episode it may name a chapter by its position. Use it when the user tells Carl to leave a hot take, post a comment, or reply to the conversation.

chapter_position.description: The position of the podcast episode's chapter the hot take is about, from 0 for the first.

parent_id.description: The id of the hot take this one replies to, if it is a reply.

target_id.description: The id of the finding, the podcast episode, the topic, or the topic post.

target_kind.description: What it is on: a finding, a podcastEpisode, a topic, or a post, which is a topic's Open Mic post.

name: post_hot_take
title: Add a hot take
